question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The bishop wore a **mitre** embroidered with gold thread.

options.text: The welder fitted a steel mitre joint at a 45° angle.
The cardinal's mitre was trimmed in crimson.
The procession displayed an ancient mitre in a glass case.
The children admired the sparkling mitre on the altar.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1** i.e. **The welder fitted a steel mitre joint at a 45° angle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mitre"** in the given sentence refers to a ceremonial headdress worn by bishops. (बिशप की टोपी)

 
 
• **Example:** The bishop placed the mitre on his head before the religious ceremony began.
 
 
 
• The homonym **"mitre"** also refers to a type of joint made by cutting two pieces at an angle, usually 45°, so they fit together neatly. (कोणीय जोड़)
 
 
• **Example:** The carpenter carefully crafted a mitre joint to join the wooden frames perfectly.
 
 
 
• Both words are spelled the same but have **different meanings**, which makes them homonyms.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** The cardinal's mitre was trimmed in crimson. (बिशप की टोपी) – This refers to the same religious headdress, not a different meaning.
 
• **Option 3:** The procession displayed an ancient mitre in a glass case. (बिशप की टोपी) – Again, it refers to the ceremonial headgear.
 
• **Option 4:** The children admired the sparkling mitre on the altar. (बिशप की टोपी) – This also refers to the religious headpiece, not a different meaning.
